purpose: Acceptance fixture for a separate Drik-compatible Venus Asta/Udaya implementation. It must not be used to tune or validate the Surya-siddhanta Chapter IX K/C model.

eventSemantics.warning: The exact internal event definition and observer coordinates used by Drik have not been independently established. These timestamps are comparison targets, not a complete physical-visibility specification.

source.captureMethod: Values transcribed from user-provided reference data in this conversation; must be re-captured from the source with each city explicitly selected before final acceptance.

requiredBeforePass: Re-capture each event from the named city selection on the Drik source page and record capture timestamp and location settings.
Establish the event definition and time convention sufficiently to compare like with like.
Record the implementation's observer coordinates, elevation, pressure, temperature, refraction and horizon assumptions.
Run independent ephemeris/observer validation; same-engine interpolation checks alone are insufficient.
Publish per-boundary signed time error and a pre-declared tolerance before declaring a pass.
